environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). No request inspection or filtering. Kafka topic 'user-updates' has open ACLs allowing any authenticated producer. The HTTP endpoint is publicly accessible on port 443 via the ALB.

config.kafka_acl: ALLOW * on topic user-updates for WRITE
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
